title: Advanced Auditing and Other Assurance Services

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the influence of legal environment and regulations on auditing and assurance services.
Analyze ethical standards applicable during the audit process.
Analyze the professional responsibilities of auditors during the audit process.
Explain the requirements and principles of quality management in auditing and assurance services.
Analyze issues in deciding to accept a client for auditing or assurance services.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Past Financial Report Audit Issues Handling
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Handle special problems arising during the audit of past financial reports.
Identify audit techniques applied at each stage of the audit process.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Future Financial Report Audit Process Explanation
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the steps in the audit process for future financial reports.
Identify audit techniques applied in fraud audits.
Explain the purpose of social responsibility audits and the steps in their audit process.
Apply integrated knowledge of auditing to solve problems in the audit process.
Apply integrated knowledge about management, risk management, and control to improve audit findings and processes.
Identify advantages and disadvantages when applying audit standards in the audit process.
Determine conditions for applying each audit method in designing and implementing audit procedures.
Consider audit issues in a globalized environment and make decisions based on ethical standards.
Control audit quality under conditions of providing auditing and assurance services.
Combine information to evaluate acceptance of a client.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Special Cases in Past Financial Report Audits
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Make decisions in special cases during the audit of past financial reports.
Implement the audit service process related to auditing and assurance services.
Implement the audit service process for future financial reports.
Implement the audit service process for fraud audits.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Social Responsibility, Environmental, and Public Sector Audit Implementation
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Implement the audit service process for social responsibility, environmental, and public sector audits.
Implement the report writing process according to each type of audit or assurance service.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Information Combination for Report Content Determination
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Combine appropriate information to determine the content and conclusions presented in the report format, including combined reports.
Combine effective methods to transmit information through financial statement audit reports and combined reports, ensuring compliance and effectiveness.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Compliance with Legal Requirements and Ethical Standards
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Comply with laws, regulations, and professional ethical standards throughout the audit process.
